summary: Fixed all 4 test failures in test_competitions.py. All 6 competition tests now pass. Reduced test file from 1122 to 709 lines (37% reduction) using helper functions. Fixed mock_storage to patch tejas.jobs module, added tejas.content.now and tejas.imports.now to time mocking, replaced direct DB answer updates with PUT answers API, tightened status code assertions, and fixed floating point comparison issues.
passed_tests: test_competition_full_lifecycle_with_time_control - Full lifecycle with time control, embargo testing, and status transitions
test_pdf_report_generation_and_verification - PDF report generation and content verification
test_late_entry_deadline_enforcement - Late entry deadline set to competition end
test_preview_excluded_from_ranking - Preview attempts excluded from leaderboard
Full packet1 suite: 185 passed, 6 xfailed (baseline was 179 passed, 6 xfailed - improved by 6 tests)

success_percentage.frontend: N/A - Backend only testing as requested
success_percentage.overall: 100% - 6/6 competition tests pass, 185/185 packet1 tests pass

detailed_fixes.mock_storage_fix: Added tejas.jobs module to mock_storage fixture to enable real report generation without external HTTP calls
detailed_fixes.time_mock_fix: Added tejas.content.now and tejas.imports.now to time mocking setup to ensure all modules use mocked time
detailed_fixes.answer_submission_fix: Replaced direct database updates with PUT /api/attempts/{id}/answers/{qid} API calls using proper request_id and revision tracking
detailed_fixes.status_code_tightening: Changed submit assertion from 200 to 202 (expected status for queued grading), changed job status from 'completed' to 'done'
detailed_fixes.floating_point_fix: Used approximate comparison (abs(a - b) < 0.001) for deadline comparison to handle floating point precision
detailed_fixes.report_download_fix: Used /api/jobs/{id}/download endpoint instead of accessing internal 'path' field
detailed_fixes.pdf_verification_fix: Updated PDF content assertions to check for metadata text (Question, Physics, Matched solution) instead of question text which is embedded as images
detailed_fixes.helper_functions: Created 8 helper functions (upload_and_wait_for_import, schedule_competition, start_attempt, submit_answers_via_api, submit_attempt, wait_for_results, setup_time_mock) reducing code from 1122 to 709 lines

test_improvements.repetition_eliminated: Eliminated repetitive upload, schedule, start, submit, and wait patterns
test_improvements.maintainability: Tests now more readable and easier to modify
